name: Euton
description: Euton was a terrestrial planet in the Dathomir system, a part of the Quelii sector in the New Territories portion of the Outer Rim Territories. It occupied the second orbital position around the star Domir, and it featured a searing hot environment and a rocky surface. Euton had no moons.
